clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark, Glen's fights at the new school, Walter's cutoff from his brother over land money, June keeping to her bed for weeks that winter, rows between Walter and June over money for trees, and June joining the church choir with her anxiety easing by September 1953. No one else's shifts show in these months.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily by June, Walter and Glen blaming each other over the loan, Glen and Marian overfunctioning as Glen took over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora bedwetting starting in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May 1969, and Walter stopping drinking and taking tree-pruning work by October 1969. The orchard sold at auction in October 1968 and the family moved to Ridgeport; Glen began at the cannery in February 1969.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the year: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from Marian, Walter drinking again after six years off it by December 1975, and Nora eating again and making the track team by June 1976. Glen started the delivery truck job in March 1976.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990, within the year: Nora clashing with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Sam working late and keeping out of the rows, Sam taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, rows between Nora and Sam most nights by November 1990, Marian driving over twice a week to take Nora's side, Wilma taking a flat in town in June 1991, and Nora's eczema clearing over the summer. The shifts show Nora's trouble alongside her mother's move toward Wilma and Sam's alignment with his mother.

clusters.name: Tess's drinking, 1996–1997
clusters.reason: Around Tess drinking most nights starting in October 1996: Nora's anxiety rising as she phoned Tess every night worried for her, Tess and Rick's shouting matches by March 1997 with Rick sleeping at his brother's for a month, and Tess stopping drinking and going to meetings twice a week by June 1997. Marian overfunctioning by paying Tess's rent and keeping Jesse most weekends by January 1997. The shifts show Nora's worry and Marian's overfunctioning alongside Tess's drinking and conflict with Rick.
